verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const dir="supabase/migrations";if(!fs.existsSync(dir))process.exit(79);const files=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith(".sql"));const guarded=files.some(f=>{const s=fs.readFileSync(p.join(dir,f),"utf8");return /create\s+trigger\s+\S+\s+before\s+insert\s+or\s+update\s+on\s+public\.event_rsvps/i.test(s)&&/attended_at/i.test(s)&&/\braise\b/i.test(s)});if(!guarded){console.error("SCAN-696: no BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger on public.event_rsvps checks attended_at, so the update-own RLS policy still lets a member self-approve, self-mark attendance and set any plus_ones on their own RSVP row.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Scans every migration for a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger on public.event_rsvps whose body names attended_at and raises; none exists today, so the RLS update-own policy is the only gate on the row and it checks ownership alone.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-10-05: migration 20270345011900 (already applied to production) adds trg_a_event_rsvps_member_write_guard, a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger on public.event_rsvps running guard_event_rsvp_member_write(), an invoker function that passes service_role, postgres, supabase_admin and guest rows unchanged and otherwise refuses (42501) an approval_status other than none or pending on insert or a change to anything but pending on update, and any write to attended_at, attended_by, guest_*, seat_token_hash or from_ticket_id; it sorts before trg_enforce_event_rsvp_capacity. supabase/tests/event_rsvps_member_write_guard.test.sql runs each forged write as the member and the host paths as postgres. The plus_ones ceiling the finding also asked for is SCAN-813. Verified by the row probe and check:migrations; pgTAP runs in CI (no Supabase CLI in the sandbox).
